content_sections.heading: About CEC
content_sections.text: The Consortium for Educational Communication is described in its notice as an Inter-University Centre of the University Grants Commission on Electronic Media. It is located at I.U.A.C. Campus, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi – 110 067. The notice is signed by Prof. Parikshat Singh Manhas, Project Director.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Field Investigator – II, with the following requirements. Age: candidates must be under 40 years. The notice prints no date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Experience (preference): preference will be given to candidates with experience in field surveys, data collection, interviews, community engagement, and research. Assets: familiarity with the study region and proficiency in the local language are considered assets.

rows.essential_qualification: Strong academic record, as defined by the relevant university, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a Master's degree in MBA (Hospitality & Tourism), MTM, or MTA

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly payment of Rs. 5000/- (consolidated). The notice describes the position as 01 position for 2 months. It is a temporary, project-based appointment, contingent on satisfactory performance and ongoing project funding. The position is valid for the duration of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CEC Field Investigator – II
content_sections.text: Prepare the application on plain paper with a complete CV and other relevant documents, including details of experience. Attach self-attested copies of degrees and certificates to the latest CV. Send the application through e-mail only to [email protected] . Write "Application for the Post of Field Investigator – ICSSR Project" in the subject line of the e-mail. Make sure the application reaches the office by or before 20 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview, which is to be held on 26 November 2026. The interview will be conducted in hybrid mode. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria or the marking scheme.
